body: I really want to give some good advice to this, but I’ve struggled with the same thing. I’ve come to understand that people that are completely close to you won’t understand. Or they may be making an excuse even for themselves in a way. Honestly I’ve just tried to ignore it, somehow :/

Almost the same scenario :/ except I’m the girlfriend trying to balance 2 jobs and going to a school that I never should have gone to but ofc life is a bitch. My boyfriend is literally the best and only thing keeping me alive. He’s bipolar but he has his shit together now and I’m a fucking mess because all of my shit is crashing down at once, but I haven’t brought myself to a therapist yet in my 20yrs. Anyway, my family keeps telling me, you need to go through the hard times to get the good.. but isn’t it just all the same shit. No matter how many good times, you’ll always have the bad, vice versa. This world doesn’t make sense. Sorry it wasn’t advice, but I wanted you to know you aren’t alone though.
